arabic text: SAJJAD REHAAI PAAKAR BHI, PARDES SE GHAR KO AA KAR BHI
english translation text: EVEN WHEN IMAM SAJJAD (A.S.) WAS FREED, AND RETURNED TO HIS HOME FROM THE FOREIGN LAND…

arabic text: JAB ASHK BAHATE REHTE THAY, ZAINAB SE DUKH DEKHE NA GAYE
english translation text: WHEN HE WOULD CRY CONTINUOUSLY, ZAINAB (A.S.) COULD NOT BEAR TO SEE HIS PAIN

arabic text: EK ROZ TADAP YE POOCHA, SAJJAD TU KAB TAK ROYEGA, US WAQT MERE MAULA NE KAHA
english translation text: ONE DAY SHE TREMBLED AND ASKED 'SAJJAD, UNTIL WHEN WILL YOU CRY?' TO THIS MY MASTER RESPONDED...

arabic text: AMMA APNE MUQADDAR PAR, SUGHRA KE SAWALO PAR, KYUN NA ROYE SAJJAD
english translation text: 'O MOTHER WHY SHOULD SAJJAD NOT CRY ON HIS DESTINY AND ON SUGHRA’S QUESTIONS?'

arabic text: AY MERI PHUPI INSAF TU KAR NAIZE PE JO DEKHE BAAP KA SAR
english translation text: O MY AUNT, IN ALL FAIRNESS WHEN SOMEONE WITNESSES HIS FATHER’S HEAD ON A SPEAR

arabic text: HO SAATH SAFAR MAY WO JISNE CHEERA THA ALI AKBAR KA JIGAR
english translation text: WHEN THE ONE WHO PIERCED ALI AKBAR’S CHEST IS TRAVELLING WITH YOU

arabic text: DURRO KI SAZA MILTI HO JAHAN BACHON KO ASHK BAHANE PAR
english translation text: WHEN CHILDREN WOULD CRY THEY WOULD BE PUNISHED BY GETTING WHIPPED

arabic text: KYUN NA ROYE SAJJAD
english translation text: WHY SHOULDN’T SAJJAD CRY?

arabic text: TUM CHUP CHUP KAR KHOON ROTI HO MAI ROUN KO KYUN KEHTI HO
english translation text: YOU SILENTLY CRY TEARS OF BLOOD SO WHY DO YOU STOP ME FROM CRYING?

arabic text: ROYA NA KARO AY LAAL MERE BHAI KO GAWAKAR BAITHI HOO
english translation text: CRY NOT O MY SON I HAVE ALSO LOST MY BROTHER

arabic text: MASOOM BEHAN KO ZINDAN MAY JO CHOR KE TANHA AAYA GHAR
english translation text: LEAVING MY INNOCENT SISTER ALONE IN THE PRISON, I HAVE RETURNED HOME

arabic text: NAIZE SE GIRA ABBAS KA SAR MAI DEKH CHUKA HOO WO MANZAR
english translation text: I HAVE WITNESSED THE SCENE WHEN ABBAS’S HEAD FELL FROM THE SPEAR

arabic text: DARBAR MAY MAI KYUN MAR NA GAYA JAB NAAM TUMHARA LE LE KAR
english translation text: WHY DID I NOT DIE WHEN YOUR NAME WAS CALLED IN THE PALACE?

arabic text: KEHTA THA LAYEEN ZAINAB HAI KAHAN LE AAO YAHAN PAR BE-CHADAR
english translation text: THE OPPRESSOR WOULD SAY, 'WHERE IS ZAINAB? BRING HER HERE WITHOUT A VEIL '

arabic text: SAB QATL HUE MAI ZINDA HOO BEMAAR SAHI LAD SAKTA THA
english translation text: EVERY ONE WAS MASSACRED AND I AM ALIVE...ALTHOUGH I WAS ILL I COULD FIGHT

arabic text: SHARMINDA HOO MAI ASGHAR SE WO TEER E SITAM SE LADH TO GAYA
english translation text: I AM ASHAMED THAT EVEN ASGHAR FOUGHT WITH THE ENEMIES AND GOT STRUCK BY AN ARROW

arabic text: WO TEER MERE KYUNKAR NA LAGA JIS TEER SE GHAYAL THA ASGHAR
english translation text: WHY DID THE SAME ARROW WHICH STRUCK ASGHAR NOT STRIKE ME?

arabic text: KYUN SAAMNE SUGHRA KE JAUN BEHTAR TO YEHI HAI MAR JAUN
english translation text: HOW SHOULD I FACE SUGHRA? IT WOULD BE BETTER TO DIE INSTEAD

arabic text: TUM ZINDA HO AKBAR NA RAHA WO POOCHE TO KYA BATLAUN
english translation text: IF SHE ASKS 'YOU ARE ALIVE AND AKBAR WAS KILLED', WHAT WOULD I TELL HER?

arabic text: KYA SABR KARO KYA ZAPT KAROO HAI ZAKHM BAHOT DIL KE ANDAR
english translation text: HOW CAN I BE PATIENT? THERE ARE WAY TOO MANY PAINS IN MY HEART

arabic text: SAR TASHT MAY THA BABA KA RAKHA AUR TAQT PE QAATIL BAITHA THA
english translation text: MY FATHER’S HEAD WAS PLACED ON A TRAY AND THE MURDERER SAT ON THE THRONE

arabic text: DANDAANE MUBARAK PAR UNKE KHUSH HOKE CHADI WO MAARTA THA
english translation text: HE WOULD REJOICE AND HIT MY FATHER’S TEETH WITH A STICK

arabic text: AFSOS MAI KUCH BHI KAR NA SAKA AB TAK HAI USI SE DARD E JIGAR
english translation text: UNFORTUNATELY I WAS NOT ABLE TO DO ANYTHING AND I FEEL THIS PAIN TILL TODAY

arabic text: REHAN O RAZA ROTAY REHNA IS DEHR MAY HAI JAB TAK JEENA
english translation text: O REHAN AND RAZA (POET) CRY ON THIS EARTH TILL YOU LIVE

arabic text: NAUHON KI AZAANE DE DE KAR HAR SHAKS SE YE KEHTE REHNA
english translation text: WITH YOUR NAWHAS KEEP TELLING THE WORLD

arabic text: BE GOR O KAFAN MASOOM BEHAN ZINDAN MAY HO JISKE HAATHON PAR
english translation text: HE WAS CARRYING HIS INNOCENT SISTER IN THE PRISON WHO HAD NO SHROUD
